extracted.name: Sesame Noodles
extracted.description: Recipe video above. Sesame Noodles tossed in a wicked Asian Sesame Peanut Dressing! Terrific served at room temperature or warm, this is a great side dish. Or turn it into a complete meal by adding shredded salads like carrots, cabbage and bean sprouts, and how about some shredded chicken too? Serves 6 - 8 as a side.
ingredient_lines: 1 tbsp sesame seeds, (plus more for garnish)
2 - 3 tbsp crushed peanuts, (optional, plus more for garnish)
1 tbsp Chinese sesame paste or tahini ((Note 3))
2 tsp garlic chilli paste, like Sambal Oelak, or Sriracha (adjust to taste) ((Note 4))
instruction_lines: Cook noodles per packet directions. Drain then briefly rinse under tap to stop them sticking together.
Place Sauce ingredients in a bowl. Mix until smooth – microwave briefly if required to assist.
Place the noodles in a large bowl, add shallots, dressing, sesame seeds and peanuts if using. Toss well. Garnish with more sesame seeds. Serve warm or at room temperature.
